insert into bi_portal.sys_auth_apply_record (apply_id, task_id, auth_type, auth_info, create_time, created_by) values
(#{record.applyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{record.taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{record.authType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{record.authInfo,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{record.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{record.createdBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT apply_id, task_id, auth_type, auth_info, create_time, created_by, approve_finish_time FROM bi_portal.sys_auth_apply_record WHERE created_by = #{userName} AND auth_type = 'ssm' AND auth_info IS NOT NULL AND auth_info != '' ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT t.item_code FROM bi_portal.sys_data_auth t WHERE t.owner_type = 'User' AND t.owner_id = #{userName} AND t.module_code = 'ssd_ctg' AND t.dim_code = 'ssm_ctg' AND t.created_time > DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL -1 * t.active_duration_days DAY) UNION SELECT t1.item_code FROM bi_portal.sys_data_auth t1 INNER JOIN bi_portal.sys_user_role sur ON t1.owner_id = sur.ROLE_ID WHERE t1.owner_type = 'Role' AND sur.USER_NAME = #{userName} AND t1.module_code = 'ssd_ctg' AND t1.dim_code = 'ssm_ctg' AND sur.created_time > DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL -1 * sur.active_duration_days DAY) UNION SELECT t1.item_code FROM bi_portal.sys_data_auth t1 INNER JOIN bi_portal.hr_employee hr ON CONCAT(hr.dept_id, '/') LIKE CONCAT('%', t1.owner_id, '/%') WHERE t1.owner_type = 'Dept' AND hr.USER_NAME = #{userName} AND t1.module_code = 'ssd_ctg' AND t1.dim_code = 'ssm_ctg' AND t1.created_time > DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL -1 * t1.active_duration_days DAY) ) m

SELECT m.module_code AS moduleCode, m.module_name AS moduleName, m.dim_code AS dimCode, m.dim_name AS dimName, m.item_code AS itemCode, m.item_value AS itemValue FROM ( SELECT t.module_code, t.module_name, t.dim_code, t.dim_name, t.item_code, t.item_value, t.created_time FROM bi_portal.sys_data_auth t WHERE t.owner_type = 'User' AND t.owner_id = #{userName} AND t.module_code = 'ssd_ctg' AND t.dim_code = 'ssm_ctg' AND t.created_time > DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL -1 * t.active_duration_days DAY) UNION ALL SELECT t1.module_code, t1.module_name, t1.dim_code, t1.dim_name, t1.item_code, t1.item_value, t1.created_time FROM bi_portal.sys_data_auth t1 INNER JOIN bi_portal.sys_user_role sur ON t1.owner_id = sur.ROLE_ID WHERE t1.owner_type = 'Role' AND sur.USER_NAME = #{userName} AND t1.module_code = 'ssd_ctg' AND t1.dim_code = 'ssm_ctg' AND sur.created_time > DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL -1 * sur.active_duration_days DAY) UNION ALL SELECT t1.module_code, t1.module_name, t1.dim_code, t1.dim_name, t1.item_code, t1.item_value, t1.created_time FROM bi_portal.sys_data_auth t1 INNER JOIN bi_portal.hr_employee hr ON CONCAT(hr.dept_id, '/') LIKE CONCAT('%', t1.owner_id, '/%') WHERE t1.owner_type = 'Dept' AND hr.USER_NAME = #{userName} AND t1.module_code = 'ssd_ctg' AND t1.dim_code = 'ssm_ctg' AND t1.created_time > DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL -1 * t1.active_duration_days DAY) ) m ORDER BY m.created_time DESC LIMIT 1
